title: Nourishing Steamed Venezuelan Fish Ceviche
description: A pescatarian friendly dish featuring vinaigrette dressing and steam, this Venezuelan fish ceviche is a quick fix earthy and molten meal, served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Cut the fish fillets into small pieces and place them in a steamer basket.
Steam the fish for 5 minutes or until it is cooked through.
In a bowl, mix together lime juice, olive oil, minced onion, minced garlic, chopped cilantro, salt, and pepper.
Add the steamed fish to the bowl and toss to coat with the vinaigrette dressing.
Remove the hot stone plate from the oven and place the fish mixture on it.
Let it sit for 1 minute to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the steamed Venezuelan fish ceviche immediately.
